name: Defiance
source: Your career takes a turn when the paper you write for is bought out by a sexy, enigmatic stranger. Are rumors about his dominant kinks true? Submit to his will and keep your job, or rebel in "Defiance".
translation: 你供职的报社被一位性感而神秘的陌生人收购，你的事业也迎来了转折。传闻中，他偏好在亲密关系中掌控对方，这是真的吗？你会服从他的意志保住工作，还是奋起反抗？
